name: Rite of Wisdom
summary: At Red Rocks, the Rite of Wisdom brings the Rites of the Earthmother to their final trial. After the Rite of Vision clears your sight, you travel to commune with an Ancestral Spirit and seek the dead’s blessing.

sections.title: The Trial of Red Rocks
sections.body: After the Rite of Vision clears your sight, you travel east of Thunder Bluff to Red Rocks. Those buried here fought and died so Mulgore could know peace, and their spirits still linger. Approach their resting place with reverence and seek communion. The hills are guarded by threats as you seek counsel from the honored dead.

sections.title: Passing the Mantle
sections.body: At Red Rocks’ summit, you commune with an Ancestral Spirit. The meeting tests your spiritual readiness and your place in the generations, not your strength in battle. These spirits fought beside Cairne Bloodhoof to establish Thunder Bluff and protect the tribes. Their blessing marks you as an adult and defender. You are charged with protecting the city and may enter Thunder Bluff with pride.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rite of Wisdom?
aliases: what does rite of wisdom do
faq.answer: The Rite of Wisdom is the final trial of the Rites of the Earthmother. Its ancestral blessing joins the vision of youth with the duties of adulthood and marks you as ready to defend Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who sends you on the Rite of Wisdom?
aliases: where do i start rite of wisdom
faq.answer: Seer Wiserunner sends you from his cave northwest of Bloodhoof Village after you complete the Rite of Vision and drink from the Water of the Seers.

faq.q: Where do you find the Ancestral Spirit?
faq.answer: You find the Ancestral Spirit at Red Rocks, an ancient tauren burial ground in the rocky bluffs directly east of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why is the Rite of Vision required first?
faq.answer: The Rite of Vision cleanses your spiritual sight with the Water of the Seers. This lets you perceive the ancient spirits at Red Rocks and receive their blessing.

faq.q: What happens after completing the Rite of Wisdom?
aliases: what next after rite of wisdom
next quest after rite of wisdom
faq.answer: After earning the ancestors’ approval, you are instructed to journey into the high rises of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What creatures threaten the grounds of Red Rocks?
faq.answer: Aggressive Palemane gnolls have encroached on Red Rocks’ sacred graveyard. They lurk along the rocky trails to the ancient burial site.

angles.text: As a shu'halo, receiving the ancestors’ mantle at Red Rocks marks your passage into full adulthood and acceptance among the tribal elders.
As a shaman, you honor the dead by communing with an Ancestral Spirit. You keep faith with the spirits that watch over Mulgore.
As a druid, you see the balance between the living world and the eternal cycle overseen by the Earthmother. Your duty is to the land.
